scope: All four preregistered A1/B1/A2/B2 trials. Same candidate loadJARs in both arms;node433/node100us fixed;clientMediaDriver1ms(A)/100us(B),owner loop1ms fixed;leader0,sync2,2gheaps,W128/Q64,mux1,MTU1248,22k/s×350k fresh arrivals per independent state. One existing CPU host,threeJVMs,loopbackUDP. Window goodput excludes drain. Accepted-only tails are conditional;all-offered accepted p99 stays unavailable with any loss. CPU means use approximate window samples per owned process;host/cgroup is shared and counted once. No sustained ceiling,three-machine isolation,HTTP/PG/WS,100M or hard real-time proof.

backlog.scope: Non-atomic queue_depth + in_flight observations; not exact queue conservation. Growth is positive OLS trend times observed span in the second half of the arrival window; drain samples excluded.

comparisonConfiguration.loadModel: absolute fixed-arrival scheduler; bounded round-robin per-worker FIFO; one synchronous in-flight per worker
comparisonConfiguration.workload: independent one-lot IOC buys, one pre-funded GTC maker, one trade per accepted command

configuration.clientDriverCountScope: load phase only; count recorded after every worker connects; setup/validation excluded
configuration.loadModel: absolute fixed-arrival scheduler; bounded round-robin per-worker FIFO; one synchronous in-flight per worker
configuration.timeouts: A timeout is unknown. Worker retries the identical identity before advancing; original and resolved completion times remain distinct.
configuration.workload: independent one-lot IOC buys, one pre-funded GTC maker, one trade per accepted command

trials.configurationIdentityScope: Checks completeness and agreement of declared node source/deployment, separate load-generator source/deployment, prepared-state and configuration identities. Missing all load-generator fields means the historical common node/load bundle; any explicit load-generator identity requires all three fields. Artifact bytes and actual node configuration require separate deployment evidence. Rate, worker count and queue size are not inside this fingerprint; grouping additionally separates phase/workers/queue.

fixedLeaderCheck.scope: All recorded CnC samples plus official pre/post list-members views; requires complete collector files from the pre-ready point through post-measurement. This checker cannot infer missing time coverage or exclude unobserved transitions between samples. Source type/label mappings are fixed to Aeron 1.53.3 clusterId=0.
